description: WLV Einzugsgebiet Lawine is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Wildbach- und Lawinenverbauung (WLV / BMLUK). Prescribed avalanche catchment areas of Austria: An avalanche (within the meaning of Paragraph 99(2) of the ForstG) is a mass of snow which, in the event of a rapid fall on steep slopes, ditches, etc., is caused by kinetic energy or by the Air pressure wave or through its deposition can cause hazards or damage. Coverage: Wildbach- und Lawinenverbauung (WLV / BMLUK). The portal shows the English title as "WLV catchment area avalanche" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Wildbach- und Lawinenverbauung (WLV / BMLUK). Its keywords include HighValueDataset. The listing shows 2026-08-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
